summary: Short parked-up kerb by a junction, apartments 11 m behind on same side.

drivers.seclusion: Orion on York apartments 11 m and another block 11 m away on the same side; Insignia 19 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where cars already sit; enough length for one van.
drivers.traffic: Close to the junction so turning traffic passes; otherwise quiet residential.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 1/4P short-stay signs apply 7-9am and 2-4pm weekdays.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Open to sky; tall building on the west side shades the afternoon.

best_section.where: West kerb of York Street just south of the junction, beside the apartment block
